title: Taurus vs Scorpio: Who Says It First
old_caption:
Who says I love you first? These two waited five months to find out.
Sometimes you both meant it the whole time.

title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: The 2 A.M. Scroll
old_caption:
It's 2 a.m. One more video, or their profile again?
Phone face down. Tomorrow is nicer than the scroll.

title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Whose Family for the Holidays
old_caption:
Whose family for the holidays? Both of you said mine.
One talk, one calendar, one day each.

title: Leo vs Aquarius: Post Us or Not
old_caption:
Post the couple photo tonight, or keep it just yours?
Leo and Aquarius met in the middle: post the shoes.

title: Virgo vs Pisces: Moving On
old_caption:
Delete the photos or keep them in a folder you never open?
There is no right speed for moving on. Only yours.

title: The Zodiac Votes: Call or Text
old_caption:
Call or text? Twelve signs ran to opposite sides.
Then a third option showed up and everyone switched teams.

title: The Zodiac Votes: Plan or Surprise
old_caption:
Plan the whole date, or surprise me? The zodiac tied.
The winning move: just ask what they'd like.

title: The Zodiac Votes: After a Fight
old_caption:
After a fight, who texts first? Everyone said them. For a whole day.
It should be whoever misses them first.

title: The Zodiac Votes: Single at Midnight
old_caption:
Single at midnight: sad or sparkly?
Pisces started on the sad side. The friends had other plans.

title: Pisces: 30 Choices, Don't Cry
old_caption:
Pisces has to answer 30 love questions without crying. It does not go well.
Stay for question 30. It's the one that matters.
